summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) & 17(4) of Electricity Act, 2003 seeking approval for creation of security interest over all of the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 2 as the Security Trustee acting for the benefit of the Lender in respect of the Petitioner’s transmission project. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for the creation of security interest over its movable and immovable assets in favour of Respondent No. 2, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Security Trustee"), acting for and on behalf of and for the benefit of Respondent Nos. 1 i.e., Axis Bank Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Lender"), including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, pursuant to the Security Trustee Agreement, Facility Agreement and other financing documents executed in connection with the Project. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _“(a) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/mortgage/ charge/pledge/assignment (as applicable), over the assets listed at Paragraph 20 above, and all the movable and immovable assets, accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender/Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed/to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and substitutes thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by executing deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, Indenture of Mortgage, Mortgage by deposit of title_ _(b) Pass such other orders that this Commission deems fit in the facts and circumstances of this case.”_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement, it is required to create security interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: - (a) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claim, and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Documents, duly acknowledged and consented to by the relevant counter-parties to such Project Documents and subject to the terms of such Project Documents; 6. The Petitioner has submitted that, as per Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, it is entitled to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables or the Transmission Project Assets in favour of the lender(s) or lenders’ representative (as defined in the TSA) as security for amounts payable under the Financing Agreements. Therefore, the Petitioner has the full right to create a security interest and charge in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited for the benefit of the lenders, subject to conditions prescribed under Article 15 of the TSA. 9. The Petition was listed for hearing on 30.4.2026. When the matter was called, none appeared on behalf of the Petitioner. However, upon noting that the present Petition seeks approval for the creation of a security interest over the assets of the Petitioner, the notice was issued in the matter. 10. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as "RoP") dated 30.4.2026, the Petitioner was directed to implead Adani Renewable Energy Park Rajasthan Limited (hereinafter referred to as "AREPRL") as a party to the present Petition, file a revised Memo of Parties, and furnish the information sought by the Commission vide letter dated 12.1.2026. Further, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 11. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that, in compliance with the directions issued vide RoP dated 30.4.2026, the Petitioner has filed a revised memo of parties vide affidavit dated 1.6.2026. It was further submitted that the information sought by the Commission vide its letter dated 12.1.2026 has also been furnished. 12. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has filed a compliance affidavit dated 1.6.2026, furnishing the information sought vide the previous RoPs. It was further submitted that, by affidavit dated 17.6.2026, the Petitioner has placed on record the “No Due Certificates” issued by the lenders, evidencing repayment of the loan facilities availed by it. Accordingly, learned counsel for the Petitioner prayed that the matter be reserved for orders. 17. The Petitioner has submitted that it is permitted to create encumbrances over - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 19. The Petitioner and the Lender have appointed Catalyst Trusteeship Limited as the Security Trustee for the creation of a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Project. In our view, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited needs to be given comfort for the creation of security for the benefit of the Lender, as security for the financial assistance provided by them. We, therefore, accord approval allowing the Petitioner to create a Security Interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, acting as the Security Trustee for and on behalf of the Lender, including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the Project assets through execution of the Indenture of Mortgage and other financing documents relating to the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
